newsitem.title: CHINA: China signs cooperation deal with BASF.
newsitem.headline: China signs cooperation deal with BASF.

text.p: China's Ministry of Chemical Industry has signed a cooperation agreement with German chemicals group BASF AG, the China Daily said on Thursday.

Under the agreement, BASF and the ministry would cooperate in technical exchange, transfer and acquisition of technology, research, market development, trade, training and production, the newspaper said.
The cooperation would be carried out by either the ministry and BASF or other entities designated by them, it said but gave no details.

China expected its chemical industry to grow by more than nine percent a year until 2000, and planned to focus on developing fertilisers, pesticides, radial tyres, fine chemicals, petrochemicals, caustic soda and chemical equipment, it said.
